An '''individual in a blue tunic''' was one of several of [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba Desilijic Tiure's]] men who traveled with [[Ki-Adi-Mundi/Legends|Ki-Adi-Mundi]] into the [[Jundland Wastes/Legends|Jundland Wastes]] in search of the lost [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Sharad Hett]]. He was killed when he and the other thugs attacked Ki-Adi-Mundi during a [[Sandstorm/Legends|sandstorm]], which they hoped would bury his body once they killed him and threw him from the [[Bantha-II cargo skiff/Legends|skiff]] they were using as transport. During the battle, the skiff crashed due to the [[Death/Legends|death]] of the driver and so, ironically, the thugs ended up buried beneath the sands, while the Jedi escaped.
